about.title: About the collection
about.description: Each Cosmic Signature is a one-of-a-kind generative artwork, rendered from an on-chain seed by a three-body physics simulation. Anyone can reproduce it from the protocol’s records, and each one belongs to the cycle that imprinted it. A typical cycle imprints 24 new Signatures: four go to the cycle’s role holders, ten to participants chosen by Stellar Selection, and ten to Random Walk NFT anchor-holders.
